newsitem.title: UK: OPEC postpones ministerial quota monitoring meeting.
newsitem.headline: OPEC postpones ministerial quota monitoring meeting.

text.p: OPEC's four-man quota compliance committee meeting, due to take place in Iran on Sunday and Monday was postponed, OPEC sources said on Monday.
The compliance committee, which meets four times a year, was due to meet on Iran's Kish Island from March 15-17.
No new date has yet been set for the meeting.
The committee, which monitors OPEC output behaviour, is currently chaired by Iranian Oil Minister Gholamreza Aghazadeh with Nigerian Oil Minister Dan Etete and Indonesia's Ida Bagus Sudjana.
OPEC secretary general Rilwanu Lukman was also expected to attend the meeting.
OPEC on Friday said direct communications from member countries put production in February at 25.33 million barrels a day (bpd) compared to an official ceiling at 25.03 million.
But media estimates put OPEC output much higher.
A Reuters survey, one of four used by OPEC to monitor production trends, put OPEC in February at 26.77 million bpd.
